delivered.title: M2 delivered
delivered.tenant: Warehouses and bins: where goods are received and issued
delivered.auth: Stock documents: receipt, issue, transfer and count; posting moves stock
delivered.schema: Live balances and six kinds of ledger entry, traceable line by line
delivered.deploy: Moving weighted average costing, exact red-ink reversals

next.title: Next
next.body: M3 delivers procure-to-pay and order-to-cash, with an approval flow.

scope.title: Where the edge is today
scope.body: Stock can be recorded, but there are no upstream documents yet: purchasing and sales arrive in M3 and will drive stock, receivables and payables automatically. Entries marked as not open are still to come.

error.notFoundBody: Pick a module from the rail on the left.

hint.code: Upper-cased on save; unique within the organisation.
hint.purchaseFactor: Stock units in one purchasing unit; 1 box of 100 pieces → 100.
hint.standardCost: Planning cost in M1; becomes a reference once M2 adds moving average.
hint.status: Inactive items disappear from pickers; history stays readable.
hint.create: New item; code, name, type and unit are required.

item.emptyBody: Create items first — BOMs and routings reference them.

confirm.deactivateBody: Deactivate {{code}} · {{name}}? An item used by a released BOM will be refused.

hint.create: New customer or supplier; one company can be both.

partner.emptyBody: Purchasing and sales will reference these records.

confirm.deactivateBody: Deactivate {{code}} · {{name}}? It disappears from purchasing and sales pickers.

bom.searchPlaceholder: Search parent item code or name

hint.item: The parent item is fixed once created; copy to a new BOM to change it.
hint.baseQty: Output the component quantities refer to; 100 for a batch of 100.
hint.create: New BOM; save a draft first, then release it.
hint.locked: This revision is {{status}} and cannot be edited. Copy it to a new revision first.

bom.emptyBody: A BOM is the input to MRP expansion; create items first.

tree.title: Multi-level explosion
tree.hint: Quantities are multiplied through every level with loss rates applied, following released revisions only.

hint.sequence: Operations are numbered 10, 20, 30 so a step can be inserted later.
hint.create: New routing; at least one operation is needed before release.
hint.noWorkCenter: Create a work centre on the work centres tab first

routing.emptyBody: A routing defines operation order and times, the input to M4 scheduling and costing.
routing.emptyNoWorkCenter: There are no work centres yet — create one on the work centres tab first.

hint.list: A work centre carries capacity and rate: available capacity = calendar minutes × efficiency.
hint.capacity: Calendar minutes per day; 960 for two shifts.
hint.costRate: Fully loaded cost per hour, used by M5 labour costing.
hint.create: New work centre; the code must be unique.

workCenter.emptyBody: Every routing operation must run on a work centre.

confirm.deactivateBody: Deactivate {{code}}? It can no longer be used by new operations.

inventory.emptyWarehousesBody: Create a warehouse first, so goods have somewhere to go.
inventory.emptyLocations: This warehouse has no bins yet
inventory.emptyStockBody: Post a receipt and the stock will show up here.
inventory.emptyMovementsBody: Every receipt and issue shows up here once a document is posted.
inventory.emptyDocumentsBody: Create a document to receive, issue, transfer or count.

hint.code: Upper-cased on save and unique within the organisation.
hint.createWarehouse: Create a warehouse before receiving goods.
hint.createDocument: A document starts as a draft; only posting moves stock.
hint.count: A count records what was found; the system posts the difference as a gain or a loss.

confirm.post: A posted document cannot be edited, only reversed. Post {docNo}?
confirm.reverse: A red-ink document will be created; the original stays on the books. Reverse {docNo}?
confirm.deactivateWarehouse: Nothing can be received or issued in {code} once it is off. Continue?
